meta.description: AI orchestration architecture: human intent, an orchestrator with planner, agent router and model router, specialised agents, a separate model layer, n8n and Python in the automation and tool layer, data, validation, human approval and delivery.

stages.label: Human intent
stages.summary: A person, a form or an event states what needs to happen.

stages.label: Orchestrator
stages.summary: The coordinator: holds state, delegates work and decides when a result is ready.

stages.label: Plan & route
stages.summary: The goal becomes tasks; each task goes to the right agent and model.

stages.label: Specialised agents
stages.summary: Workers with one responsibility each and only the tools they need.

stages.label: Model layer
stages.summary: Cloud models and local models, chosen per task by the model router.

stages.label: Automation & tools
stages.summary: n8n runs the workflows, Python provides the programmable tools.

stages.label: Data & external systems
stages.summary: Databases, private documents and the systems that receive results.

stages.label: Validation & approval
stages.summary: Checks run on every result; a person approves anything irreversible.

stages.label: Delivery
stages.summary: Reviewed changes ship through GitHub and Vercel; messages go out by email.

nodes.label: Human · client
nodes.description: The person or client who sets the goal, the limits and what counts as done.

nodes.label: Input · goal
nodes.description: The task as the system receives it: goal, context and constraints.

nodes.label: Website form
nodes.description: A form on a website — like the contact form on this site — that starts a workflow.

nodes.label: Triggers
nodes.description: Events that start automated work: an API call, an incoming webhook or a schedule.

nodes.label: Application
nodes.description: The product people use — here a Next.js, React and TypeScript application.

nodes.label: Orchestrator
nodes.description: The central coordinator. It does not answer questions itself — it decides who works on what, keeps the state and puts the results together.

nodes.label: State · checkpoints
nodes.description: Keeps workflow state, context and checkpoints so work can resume or roll back.

nodes.label: Planner
nodes.description: Breaks the goal into small tasks, each with its own check.

nodes.label: Agent router
nodes.description: Assigns each task to the specialised agent that owns that kind of work.

nodes.label: Model router
nodes.description: Chooses a model per task by capability, privacy, cost, latency and availability. Agents never call models directly.

nodes.label: ChatGPT
nodes.description: OpenAI models for research, analysis, reasoning, specifications and content — reached only through the model router.

nodes.label: Claude
nodes.description: Claude and Claude Code for repository analysis, planning, implementation, refactoring, debugging and review.

nodes.label: Local AI
nodes.description: Self-hosted models for private data and offline-capable workflows — Ollama-, LM Studio- or llama.cpp-style runtimes with embeddings and retrieval. Shown as a capability, not a running deployment.

nodes.label: Research agent
nodes.description: Collects and analyses sources and documentation.

nodes.label: Web · browser agent
nodes.description: Reads and checks web pages, forms and live behaviour.

nodes.label: Frontend agent
nodes.description: Builds interfaces in React and Next.js.

nodes.label: Backend agent
nodes.description: Builds APIs, validation and server logic.

nodes.label: Python agent
nodes.description: Writes Python scripts, services and developer tooling.

nodes.label: Data agent
nodes.description: Parses, cleans and transforms data.

nodes.label: Testing agent
nodes.description: Writes and runs unit, end-to-end and accessibility tests.

nodes.label: Review agent
nodes.description: Reviews changes for bugs, security and quality before human approval.

nodes.label: AI integration agent
nodes.description: Connects models to products: prompts, tool calls, fallbacks and limits.

nodes.label: Local AI agent
nodes.description: Works on private documents with local models only.

nodes.label: Automation agent
nodes.description: Designs and maintains n8n workflows, webhooks and scheduled jobs.

nodes.label: Deployment agent
nodes.description: Prepares releases and rollbacks; deploys only after approval.

nodes.label: n8n
nodes.description: Workflow automation and integration. It moves data and events between systems on fixed rules and hands reasoning work to the orchestrator — it is not the AI brain. Shown as an automation architecture capability; no n8n instance runs in this portfolio.

nodes.label: Python
nodes.description: Programmable glue between AI, data and automation. The architecture on this page is generated by a Python script.

nodes.label: APIs
nodes.description: Connections to internal and external services over REST and Node.js.

nodes.label: Webhooks
nodes.description: Events in and out — how systems notify each other.

nodes.label: Files · data
nodes.description: Reads and transforms CSV, JSON and PDF files.

nodes.label: Browser · web tools
nodes.description: Fetches, renders and tests web pages; this site is checked with Playwright.

nodes.label: PostgreSQL
nodes.description: Stores records and workflow state.

nodes.label: Embeddings
nodes.description: Private documents indexed as embeddings for retrieval (RAG).

nodes.label: Private documents
nodes.description: Documents that must not leave the machine or the company network.

nodes.label: External systems
nodes.description: Where approved results land: CRM updates, notifications, third-party APIs.

nodes.label: Validation · tests
nodes.description: Schemas, types and tests. Failures go back to the responsible agent with context.

nodes.label: Human approval
nodes.description: A person approves before anything irreversible: sending, publishing, deploying or deleting.

nodes.label: Git · GitHub
nodes.description: Version control and CI. Every change is a reviewed commit.

nodes.label: Vercel
nodes.description: Builds and deploys the application.

nodes.label: Production
nodes.description: The live application, verified after every deploy.

nodes.label: Email · Resend
nodes.description: Outbound email via Resend — live for this site's contact form.

research-agent.role: Finds and summarises sources, documentation and API references, with citations.

browser-agent.role: Navigates pages, fills forms and checks live behaviour.

frontend-agent.role: Builds accessible, responsive components and pages.

backend-agent.role: Implements endpoints, validation and server logic.

python-agent.role: Writes scripts, services and tooling: generators, converters, API clients.

data-agent.role: Cleans, transforms and reconciles data between formats and systems.

test-agent.role: Writes and runs unit, end-to-end and accessibility checks.

review-agent.role: Assumes there are bugs: reviews the diff, security and copy.

ai-agent.role: Wires models into products: prompts, tool calling, fallbacks and limits.

local-agent.role: Answers over private documents with local models only — nothing leaves the machine.

automation-agent.role: Designs n8n workflows, webhooks and scheduled jobs around the AI steps.

deploy-agent.role: Prepares the release, runs the deploy and keeps a rollback ready.

workflows.label: Development
workflows.summary: From a requirement to a verified production deploy.

workflows.label: Automation
workflows.summary: An n8n workflow that hands reasoning to the orchestrator and acts only after approval.

workflows.label: AI research
workflows.summary: A research question answered with cloud models, web tools and a human review.

workflows.label: Local AI
workflows.summary: Answers over private documents without sending them to a cloud model.

workflows.label: Website lead
workflows.summary: A contact form enquiry validated, routed and delivered by email.
